summary: Escambia County lookout at the Florida Forest Service's Molino Forestry Station on Highway 29; a 2023 notice places the tower there. No build date or height found.

facts.status: standing as of Oct 2023; current condition not confirmed

evidence.supports: Molino entry gives the county as Escambia
Molino entry gives the land location code 2N-31W-21
Molino is listed in the Florida section of the Eastern US Lookouts index
Station is the Florida Forest Service's; it sits on Highway 29 under the fire tower, just south of Highway 196 (2023)
evidence.quote: The Florida Forest Service’s Molino Forestry Station is located on Highway 29, under the fire tower just south of Highway 196.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The Eastern US Lookouts entry gives name, county and land code only. The 2023 NorthEscambia.com notice is the only evidence the tower stood recently; 'standing' rests on its wording, not a site visit or register. No build date, builder, height or access rule found. Ownership left out: the notice ties the tower to the Forest Service station but does not say who owns the tower. An OSM node (358719864) tags it as an observation tower at 55 m elevation; not quoted because it is only a map tag. A search snippet cited a registry record for a 97.5 m structure in Molino (Escambia County, dated 1980); it could not be opened (403) and is not used. Comments on the NorthEscambia article mention climbing a tower at Lottie, not this one; not used.
